name: Password Strength Checker
s: Analyze a password in your browser: estimated score, entropy, crack-time ranges, common-password, pattern and repeat checks.

name: Password Breach Check
s: Check whether a password appears in the Have I Been Pwned dataset using k-anonymity. Only a 5-character hash prefix is sent.

name: Password Entropy Calculator
s: Estimate password entropy in bits from length and character pool, with notes on why pattern weaknesses can make the number optimistic.

name: Password Crack Time Estimator
s: See rough crack-time ranges for online, offline fast-hash and offline slow-hash attacks. Estimates only, with assumptions explained.

name: Password Pattern Detector
s: Detect numeric and alphabetic sequences, keyboard walks, predictable year suffixes and common-password variants locally.

name: Password Repeat Detector
s: Find repeated characters and repeated blocks such as aaa, 111, abab or abcabc in a password, entirely in your browser.

name: Common Password Checker
s: Check a password against a built-in list of very common passwords and obvious variants, locally in your browser.

name: Secure Password Generator
s: Generate strong random passwords with cryptographically secure randomness. Choose length and character sets. Nothing is stored or sent.

name: Passphrase Generator
s: Generate memorable multi-word passphrases locally with secure randomness, custom separators and entropy estimates.

name: Secure PIN Generator
s: Generate random 4, 6, 8 or 10 digit PINs with secure randomness while avoiding patterns like 1234 or 0000.

name: Random String Generator
s: Generate random strings from 1 to 256 characters with secure randomness. Choose character sets and exclude ambiguous characters.

name: UUID v4 Generator
s: Generate RFC-style version 4 UUIDs in bulk (1, 10, 50 or 100) locally using secure randomness.

name: Hash Generator
s: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of any text locally in your browser.

name: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
s: Encode and decode Base64 with proper UTF-8 handling for Bangla, emoji and other Unicode. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: QR Code Generator
s: Create QR codes for text, URLs, Wi-Fi, email and phone numbers entirely in your browser. Download PNG or SVG. Nothing is uploaded.

name: HMAC Generator
s: Compute and verify HMAC-SHA signatures for messages and webhook payloads, with a constant-time comparison.

name: Symmetric Encrypt / Decrypt (AES-256-GCM)
s: Encrypt and decrypt text or files with AES-256-GCM and a password, entirely offline in your browser.

name: Key Pair Generator
s: Generate RSA, ECDSA, Ed25519, ECDH and X25519 key pairs as PEM or JWK, locally in your browser.

name: RSA-OAEP Encrypt / Decrypt
s: Encrypt short messages with an RSA public key and decrypt them with the private key using RSA-OAEP.

name: Digital Signature Tool
s: Sign messages and verify signatures with ECDSA, Ed25519 or RSA-PSS keys in PEM or JWK form.

name: ECDH Key Exchange
s: Derive a shared secret from your private key and a peer's public key with ECDH or X25519, plus an HKDF key.

name: JWK / PEM Converter
s: Convert public and private keys between JWK (JSON) and PEM (SPKI or PKCS#8), for RSA, EC, Ed25519 and X25519.

name: Key Derivation Tool (PBKDF2, HKDF)
s: Derive keys with PBKDF2 or HKDF and measure how long your chosen iteration count takes on this device.

name: Hash Identifier
s: Identify the likely type of a hash or password-hash string from its format, prefix and length.

name: CRC and Checksum Calculator
s: Compute CRC-32, CRC-16 (CCITT-FALSE and MODBUS), CRC-8 and Adler-32 checksums of text or hex bytes.

name: Classical Cipher Tool
s: Apply Caesar, ROT13, ROT47, Atbash and Vigenere ciphers, or list all 25 Caesar shifts.

name: XOR Cipher Tool
s: XOR text or hex data with a repeating key, or brute-force a single-byte XOR key by scoring English-like output.

name: SSH Key Fingerprint
s: Compute the SHA-256 and MD5 fingerprints of an SSH public key, in the format ssh and GitHub display.

name: Merkle Tree Builder
s: Build a SHA-256 Merkle tree from a list of leaves, get the root, and create or check an inclusion proof.

name: Randomness Tester
s: Run monobit, runs and byte chi-square tests on pasted data or on bytes from the browser's secure generator.

name: TOTP and HOTP Generator
s: Generate and verify TOTP and HOTP one-time codes from a Base32 secret, with SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512.

name: OTPAuth Link and QR Builder
s: Build an otpauth:// link and QR code for authenticator apps, or parse an existing link into its settings.

name: Password Policy Checker
s: Test passwords against your own rules for length, character types, banned words, repeats and common passwords.

name: Backup Code Generator
s: Generate printable sets of random one-time recovery codes without confusing characters like 0, O, 1 and I.

name: Password Reuse Checker
s: Compare a list of passwords for exact reuse, near-duplicates and shared chunks without showing the passwords.

name: Login Lockout Calculator
s: Estimate how long attackers need to guess a PIN or password under your lockout and rate-limit policy.

name: Email Alias Generator
s: Create plus-tag and Gmail dot-variant aliases of your address to separate sign-ups and trace leaks.

name: Password CSV Auditor
s: Audit an exported password-manager CSV for weak, short, common and reused passwords without displaying the passwords.

name: MFA Method Advisor
s: Get a ranked recommendation of multi-factor methods based on account sensitivity, phishing risk and your devices.

name: Hash Wordlist Matcher
s: Match unsalted MD5 and SHA hashes against your own wordlist to audit weak passwords and solve CTF exercises.
